### 5.3 Temperature Excursion

On 2024-05-28, the temperature monitoring system logged a deviation in the -80°C freezer. The temperature rose to -68°C for a period of approximately 45 minutes between 14:10 and 14:55. The cause was traced to the freezer door not being fully closed after a sample retrieval by Study Nurse N. Huda. The alarm was acknowledged at 14:12 by the Study Coordinator, J. Wong.

The contents were assessed by the Principal Investigator, Dr. Tan. No samples were deemed compromised. The excursion was documented in the temperature excursion log (Ref: TE-07-SG-002) and reported to the sponsor on 2024-05-29. A CAPA was initiated (Ref: CAPA-2024-09) to reinforce the door-closing procedure and to add a secondary visual indicator to the freezer. The CAPA was closed on 2024-06-20 after verification that the corrective action was effective and that a 30-day monitoring period showed no further excursions.

### 5.3 Temperature Excursion

On 2024-05-28, the temperature monitoring system logged a deviation in the -80°C freezer. The temperature rose to -68°C for a period of approximately 45 minutes between 14:10 and 14:55. The cause was traced to the freezer door not being fully closed after a sample retrieval by Study Nurse N. Huda. The alarm was acknowledged at 14:12 by the Study Coordinator, J. Wong.

The contents were assessed by the Principal Investigator, Dr. Tan. No samples were deemed compromised. The excursion was documented in the temperature excursion log (Ref: TE-07-SG-002) and reported to the sponsor on 2024-05-29. A CAPA was initiated (Ref: CAPA-2024-09) to reinforce the door-closing procedure and to add a secondary visual indicator to the freezer. The CAPA was closed on 2024-06-20 after verification that the corrective action was effective and that a 30-day monitoring period showed no further excursions.
